package monstera.studio.scaffold

// Scaffold only: this file is not compiled into the app and contacts no service.

interface AdService {
    val isMock: Boolean
    fun canShow(placementId: String, nowSeconds: Int): Boolean
    fun show(placementId: String, nowSeconds: Int, onReward: (rewardKind: String, rewardAmount: Int) -> Unit): Boolean
}

object FrequencyLimit {
    fun canShow(minSecondsBetween: Int, maxPerSession: Int, shownCount: Int, lastShownSeconds: Int, nowSeconds: Int): Boolean {
        if (shownCount >= maxPerSession) return false
        if (lastShownSeconds < 0) return true
        return nowSeconds - lastShownSeconds >= minSecondsBetween
    }
}
